issues.quote: revenue rising 61.4% to $26.9 billion from $10.9 billion in fiscal 2021
issues.problem: NVIDIA's fiscal 2021 revenue was about $16.7 billion ($16.675B); $10.9 billion is the fiscal 2020 figure. The 61.4% growth rate is only consistent with $16.7B, since growth from $10.9B would be about 147%.

data.summary: All figures are correct except the fiscal 2021 revenue base, which is given as $10.9B instead of $16.7B. That makes it inconsistent with the stated 61.4% growth.
